title: EGR cooler bypass flap sticking at low temperature
symptom: Flap actuator fault code at -20 C
occurrence_cause: Bushing supplier changed material batch with higher shrinkage
escape_cause: Functional test at room temperature only
corrective_actions: Cold functional test on 1 part per lot
Supplier PPAP re-approval of bushing material
lessons_learned: Add cold-test to Control Plan for actuated parts; supplier material change notification enforced.
